author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬಾಳಬಂಡಿಯನೆಳೆಯೆ ಸಮಚಿತ್ತವೇ ಬೇಕು
ತಾಳುಮೆಯ ನಡೆಯಿರಲು ಜೀವನವೆ ಧನ್ಯ
ಏಳುಬೀಳನು ಸಹಿಸಿ ಮೌನದಿಂ ಅನುಭವಿಸೆ
ಕಾಲನೇ ಬಾಗುವನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: To pull the cart of life you need an even mind;
when patience guides your walk, life is blessed;
bearing rises and falls and living through them in silence,
even Time will bow to you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: An even mind pulls life’s cart. Patience blesses life, and one who bears ups and downs quietly is honoured even by Time.
